描述_EN: the measure (dou) represents a container for wisdom and inspiration, but also holds an astronomical meaning: dou is the chinese name for the dipper, a part of the big dipper constellation. the god is often represented holding a writing brush in his right hand and a scroll or a tablet in his left hand; here, a trapezoidal grain measure is balanced in his upturning left foot. this bronze figure portraits kui xing, a daoist star-god connected with popular beliefs and astronomy. kui xing is the chief star in the big dipper constellation, but he is also called god of literature, and worshipped by candidates to the imperial examinations. dreaming of kui xing in the night before the exams was considered an auspicious sign.
描述_ZN: "斗 "代表着智慧和灵感的容器，同时也有天文意义："斗 "是北斗星的中文名称，是北斗星的一部分。 the god is often represented holding a writing brush in his right hand and a scroll or a tablet in his left hand; here, a trapezoidal grain measure is balanced in his upturning left foot. 此铜像为魁星，一个与大众信仰和天文学有关的道教星神。 魁星是北斗七星中的主星，但他也被称为文神，并被科举考试的考生所崇拜。 在考试前的晚上梦见魁星被认为是一个吉祥的征兆。
